answer: A lighthouse keeper keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must hang its own beacon lamp behind a distinct prism, one prism, one lamp, one keeper. The nth fake owes plume feathers counted by triangular numbers: the first 1, the second 3, the third 6, the fourth 10, the fifth 15, so the tenth fake alone hangs 55 feathers and twenty fakes together hang 1,540. Bulk farming fails because one keeper tends one lamp and no market sells a lit beacon, like one shepherd tending one flock on one hill. Each feather is hung by hand, one by one, never bought or borrowed.
